name: Navayuga Engineering Company Limited
summary: A Hyderabad-based contractor known for difficult marine, tunnel and bridge work as well as highway packages.
about: Navayuga builds the kinds of structures that need specialist equipment — ports and marine works, tunnels, and long bridges — alongside ordinary highway packages. It has worked on major expressway stretches and on tunnelling projects in the Himalaya.
facts: Works on marine, tunnel and bridge projects as well as highways.
Has built expressway packages and Himalayan tunnel projects.
